{{Quote|Once we penetrated the outer passages, the inner sanctum held the sarcophagus of the great ruler, placed at the center of a power loci.|Sorzus Syn, ''Chronicle of Sorzus Syn''|<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''Bilious Torment''' was a ruler of the [[Sith (species)|Sith species]] who lived prior to [[6899 BBY]].<ref name ="Date">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' states that latter part of [[Sorzus Syn]]'s chronicle took place in the "Exile Year Two, Months 7-9." Per ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' the first year took place in [[6900 BBY]], thus the second year would be 6899.</ref> Their sarcophagus was buried in the [[Cloister of Bilious Torment]] which was named after them, alongside with their servants.<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>
